name: E5_1_xlmr_large_emotion_grid
description: Stage 1, validation only, seed 13: XLM-R large encoder-LR grid around its E4.4 value. Equal budget for both encoders: up to 8 epochs with early stopping (patience 2) on validation emotion macro-F1, fp16 autocast, batch 16, same head and head LR, three encoder LRs each. Added because every E4.1 and E4.4 run peaked at its last (third) epoch.
